correctness.rationale: The fixed-root forest enumerator gives a root-plus-uniform occupancy vector by exact coefficient comparison. Conditional on root-edge count, singleton-root and empty-nonroot occupancies are independent. A pointwise coupling establishes stochastic domination for m<=2k; the exact minimum-atom ratio m/(2k) proves failure otherwise. A separate uniform bound proves strict mean increase, and a support argument proves saturation incomparability. The extracted exact verifier passes 2,975 assertions, including independent exhaustive forest enumeration through eight labels; finite tests are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact finite cutoff m=2k identifies a natural regime in which root-edge information orders the entire leaf abundance distribution and a contrasting regime in which the law becomes incomparable although its mean increases. A separate saturation mechanism gives a second all-size obstruction. The result addresses structural inference for ordinary undirected leaves in fixed-root Cayley forests, beyond a routine moment calculation or arbitrary small slice.
